prompt.description: Your own instruction instead of the maker's default (timestamped segments with speaker labels). The maker's recipes include speaker-only transcription: "Transcribe the audio as text using speaker labels such as [S01], [S02], and [S03]."

hotwords.description: Names and terms to spell right, appended to the instruction as the maker's hotword hint.

max_new_tokens.description: Longest transcript in tokens (the maker's default 5,120); raise it for long recordings.

stream.description: Send each finished segment as it is written.
